marks.gloss_en: ת"ל מאחד שעריך -- לא אמרתי אלא בשעה שכל ישראל נכנסין בשער אחד
whence that all the watches are equal in the eimurim of the festivals? the verse says: 'and he comes with all the desire of his soul ... and serves' (Devarim 18:6-7)
אימורי הרגלים של גבוה נינהו! -- the festivals' eimurim go to the Most High; what is there for the watches to share?
מה שאמור ברגלים -- not 'eimurim' but what is stated regarding the festivals (= p_chisda_ma_sheamur)
the eimurim of the festivals belong to the Most High [so how are they shared among the watches?]
at three times in the year all the watches were equal: in the eimurim of the festivals
on Atzeret he says to him: here is matza for you, here is chametz for you
on the first festival day of the Festival there were thirteen bulls, two rams and one goat
on the second, five offer two each, and the rest one each
on the fourth, three offer two each, and the rest one each
on the seventh, all are equal
אטו שתי משמרות לא אפוסי בעי? -- the Rabbis too need a lottery between the two watches, so the mishnah's 'returned to the lottery' fits them
do the two [remaining] watches not need to cast lots [between them]? -- they do
(entertained) the mishnah is Rebbi's and not the Rabbis'
all the watches offer [bulls] twice and three times, except two watches that offer twice and not three times
one who offered bulls today does not offer [bulls] tomorrow; rather they rotate
R' Elazar: these seventy bulls -- to what do they correspond? to the seventy nations
a parable: a king of flesh and blood said to his servants, make me a great feast; on the last day he said to his beloved, make me a small feast so that I may enjoy [it] from you
R' Yochanan: woe to the nations, who lost and do not know what they lost
